name: ping
defect: Missing transport handshake.

name: lcs_empty
defect: Invalid empty-prefix base case; empty sequence is the only common subsequence.

name: lcs_noncontiguous
defect: Confusing a subsequence with a substring; all four characters of b occur in order in a.

name: lcs_ties
defect: Overconstraining reconstruction: a and b are equally valid, but length two is impossible because orders differ.

name: merge_empty
defect: Empty interval indexing; there are no merges.

name: merge_chronology
defect: Parent merge before child. The two possible schedules cost 5+9=14 and 7+9=16.

name: merge_adjacency
defect: Unrestricted Huffman merging would illegally join the two separated 1s. Each legal first merge costs 101, then 102.

name: merge_large_total
defect: 32-bit overflow. Balanced merges cost 2e9+2e9+4e9=8e9; an unbalanced schedule costs 9e9.

name: tree_empty
defect: Accessing a nonexistent root.

name: tree_negative
defect: Forcing a selection although the empty set is allowed.

name: tree_optimal_witness
defect: Choosing the single largest vertex. Nonadjacent endpoints weigh 10, versus middle weight 9.

name: naive_overlaps
defect: Skipping overlapping starts or the final valid start.

name: naive_empty_pattern
defect: Missing the last empty-pattern boundary.

name: kmp_fallback_overlap
defect: Resetting to zero after a match loses overlapping occurrences.

name: kmp_longer_pattern
defect: Reporting an incomplete pattern prefix.

name: rk_collision
defect: ab and dj both hash to 75 under base31/mod101, but only ab is equal.

name: rk_empty_both
defect: Empty strings still have one matching boundary.

name: suffix_empty
defect: Including an empty suffix or sentinel in output.

name: suffix_banana
defect: Wrong adjacent LCP direction or excluding overlaps; suffix order is a, ana, anana, banana, na, nana.

name: suffix_repetitive
defect: Wrong missing-rank order or Kasai reuse. Shorter identical-prefix suffix sorts first.

name: aho_suffix_duplicates_reset
defect: Missing suffix-pattern matches, losing duplicate columns, or accumulating counts between texts.

name: aho_dense_overlaps
defect: Nonoverlapping counting or incorrect duplicate-terminal handling. A length-k all-a pattern has 5-k starts.

name: aho_empty_dictionary
defect: Dropping empty result rows when the dictionary is empty.

name: aho_empty_texts
defect: Returning a fabricated row when no texts are supplied.

name: aho_cross_text_state
defect: Carrying automaton state across independent texts creates a false match in the second row.
